Multiple hardware experiments have been conducted to test the performance of the SST. First, component testing of the individual SST converters was conducted to validate their design. Secondly, a back-to-back test of the two four- leg converters was conducted to demonstrate how the SST responds to a simulated CM insult. Finally, a complete test (a) DAB schematic of the assembled SST was conducted to ensure the nominal input/output behavior of the device.
